note: tl_from_fl = [a, b] means TL = a * FL + b (cm), the published length-length relationship the agent checks a fish's outline (about TL) against, within fl_tl_tolerance in catchlength/agent.py. null = no sourced relationship found yet: only the broad 0.80-1.00 band applies. w_from_fl = [a, b] means round weight (kg) = a * FL(cm)^b, used only for the seller's size receipt (catchlength/seller.py), never for a check; null = no sourced fork-length curve found, so no weight is given.
